original_ai_output.title_zh: 赞法拉州九名议员据称退出APC转投ADC，执政党面临危机
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚赞法拉州全体进步大会党（APC）据报面临新的危机，九名州众议院议员以不安全、内部分歧、被指不公和治理不善为由退出该党，转投非洲民主大会党（ADC）。此次退党发生在州长Dauda Lawal从人民民主党（PDP）转投APC约七个月之后。议员退党消息最初于10月4日由多家媒体报道，当时数字为六人或八人，至10月5日多家平台报道为九人。

key_facts.fact: 赞法拉州九名州众议院议员据报退出APC转投ADC
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: nine members of the state House of Assembly reportedly defected from the party to the African Democratic Congress (ADC)

key_facts.fact: 退党议员以不安全、内部分歧、被指不公和治理不善为由
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: citing insecurity, internal divisions, alleged injustice and poor governance

key_facts.fact: 此次退党发生在州长Dauda Lawal从PDP转投APC约七个月之后
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The latest defections came barely seven months after Governor Dauda Lawal moved from the Peoples’ Democratic Party (PDP) to the APC

key_facts.fact: 退党消息最初于10月4日报道为六人或八人，10月5日多家平台报道为九人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The lawmakers’ exit was first reported by several outlets on October 4, with the number initially reported as six or eight. By October 5, several other platforms reported that nine lawmakers had dumped the APC for the ADC.

uncertainties: 议员退党人数最初报道为六人或八人，后报道为九人，具体人数尚存差异
退党消息为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
